name: Teferi's Puzzle Box
role: wheel-lock keystone (#14): everyone bottoms hand + redraws each draw step
text: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player puts the cards in their hand on the bottom of their library in any order, then draws that many cards.
note: Keystone forced-wheel; LOCK not free win. Pair with hand-punishers as clock.

name: Underworld Dreams
role: draw-punisher payoff; 1 dmg per opponent draw -> Puzzle Box/Anvil burn
text: Whenever an opponent draws a card, this enchantment deals 1 damage to that player.
note: Printed mono-B already; the primary wheel payoff. BBB cost keeps it honest.

name: Black Vise
role: the clock: X = hand size - 4 to a chosen opponent each upkeep
text:
As this artifact enters, choose an opponent.
At the beginning of the chosen player's upkeep, this artifact deals X damage to that player, where X is the number of cards in their hand minus 4.
note: COLORSHIFT->B per package. Iconic clock vs flooded hands. Turn-1 piece.

name: Iron Maiden
role: Black Vise hitting ALL opponents; X = hand - 4 each upkeep
text: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, this artifact deals X damage to that player, where X is the number of cards in their hand minus 4.
note: SURPLUS. Functionally = Black Vise in 1v1; pick ONE for singleton. Vise cheaper.

name: The Rack
role: INVERSE clock: X = 3 - hand size; punishes empty hands after a wheel discard
text:
As this artifact enters, choose an opponent.
At the beginning of the chosen player's upkeep, this artifact deals X damage to that player, where X is 3 minus the number of cards in their hand.
note: COLORSHIFT->B. Covers the OTHER axis (empty hand) vs Vise. Anvil-discard synergy.

name: Wheel of Torture
role: The Rack hitting ALL opponents; X = 3 - hand size each upkeep
text: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, this artifact deals X damage to that player, where X is 3 minus the number of cards in their hand.
note: SURPLUS. Near-dup of The Rack in 1v1; choose one for singleton.

name: Ebony Owl Netsuke
role: flooded-hand punisher: 4 dmg if an opponent has 7+ cards in hand
text: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has seven or more cards in hand, this artifact deals 4 damage to that player.
note: COLORSHIFT->B. Big payoff when Puzzle Box/Font/Memory Jar flood hands to 7+.

name: Misers' Cage
role: softer flooded-hand punisher: 2 dmg if opponent has 5+ cards
text: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has five or more cards in hand, this artifact deals 2 damage to that player.
note: COLORSHIFT->B. Lower threshold (5) than Ebony Owl; redundant-ish, surplus.

name: Cursed Rack
role: lock piece: sets a chosen opponent's max hand size to 4 (caps their wheel)
text:
As this artifact enters, choose an opponent.
The chosen player's maximum hand size is four.
This artifact has no effect on a player who controls a Library of Leng.
note: COLORSHIFT->B. Hand-size LOCK; forces discards into The Rack range. Slow, fragile.

name: Forced Fruition
role: cast-punisher: opponent draws 7 per spell -> floods their hand for Vise/Owl
text: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, that player draws seven cards.
note: Printed mono-U. Mills/overloads opp hand; pairs Black Vise/Ebony Owl as kill.

name: Fevered Visions
role: self-contained wheel-punisher: each player draws EOT, opp takes 2 if 4+ cards
text: At the beginning of each player's end step, that player draws a card. If the player is your opponent and has four or more cards in hand, this enchantment deals 2 damage to that player.
note: Printed UR gold (no shift). Engine + clock in one card; bleeds into UR guild slot.

name: Spiteful Visions
role: symmetric extra-draw + 1 dmg per ANY draw -> turns the wheel into a clock
text:
At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws an additional card.
Whenever a player draws a card, this enchantment deals 1 damage to that player.
note: Hybrid B/R; castable mono-B. Symmetric Underworld Dreams + own enabler; spicy.

name: Phyrexian Tyranny
role: draw-punisher tax: each draw costs opp 2 life unless they pay {2}
text: Whenever a player draws a card, that player loses 2 life unless they pay {2}.
note: Printed Grixis; COLORSHIFT->U/B drop the R pip. Symmetric tax; very low elo (1043).

name: Price of Knowledge
role: top-end flooded-hand payoff: each opp upkeep takes dmg = their hand size
text:
Players have no maximum hand size.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, this enchantment deals damage to that player equal to the number of cards in that player's hand.
note: 7-mana haymaker; Iron Maiden with no -4. Slow finisher for the wheel pile.

name: Sphinx's Tutelage
role: alt mill payoff: your every draw mills opp 2 (repeats on color match)
text:
Whenever you draw a card, target opponent mills two cards. If two nonland cards that share a color were milled this way, repeat this process.
{5}{U}: Draw a card, then discard a card.
note: Mill win-axis for the wheel; you draw a lot under Puzzle Box/Howling Mine.

name: Psychic Corrosion
role: mill payoff: your every draw mills each opponent 2
text: Whenever you draw a card, each opponent mills two cards.
note: Surplus mill payoff; redundant-axis with Sphinx's Tutelage, pick to taste.

name: Standstill
role: ODY-block draw engine / soft lock; refuels the wheel when it breaks
text: When a player casts a spell, sacrifice this enchantment. If you do, each of that player's opponents draws three cards.
note: Actual ODY card. Stax-y draw3; great in a low-creature lock shell. On-philosophy.

name: Day's Undoing
role: honest one-shot wheel (Timetwister); cast-and-spent refuel, ends your turn
text: Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards. If it's your turn, end the turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack, including this card. Discard down to your maximum hand size. Damage wears off, and "this turn" and "until end of turn" effects end.)
note: HONEST combo piece (rule 4): spent spell, not a board engine. Floods hand -> Vise.

name: Prosperity
role: one-shot symmetric draw X; stapled fill for Underworld Dreams / Vise kill
text: Each player draws X cards.
note: Cast-and-spent enabler. With Underworld Dreams it's symmetric Sudden Inspiration.

name: Anvil of Bogardan
role: enabler: each player loots in draw step + no max hand -> feeds punishers
text:
Players have no maximum hand size.
At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws an additional card, then discards a card.
note: Symmetric loot; the discard feeds graveyard themes, draw feeds Underworld Dreams.

name: Howling Mine
role: classic symmetric extra-draw enabler; tapping it = a real decision
text: At the beginning of each player's draw step, if this artifact is untapped, that player draws an additional card.
note: Untapped clause = meaningful tap-to-deny choice. Core wheel enabler.

name: Temple Bell
role: activated symmetric draw; you control timing of the flood for your punishers
text: {T}: Each player draws a card.
note: On-demand draw; fills hands on YOUR turn so Vise/Owl fire before opp empties.

name: Font of Mythos
role: heavy enabler: each player draws TWO extra per draw step
text: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws two additional cards.
note: Rockets hands past 7 for Ebony Owl; the hardest enabler. Surplus vs Howling Mine.

name: Otherworld Atlas
role: charge-counter wheel (counters-matter synergy): each player draws = counters
text:
{T}: Put a charge counter on this artifact.
{T}: Each player draws a card for each charge counter on this artifact.
note: Scaling symmetric draw; ties into cube's counters theme + proliferate. Slow build.

name: Memory Jar
role: shared one-shot wheel: each player exiles hand, draws 7, then discards
text: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Each player exiles all cards from their hand face down and draws seven cards. At the beginning of the next end step, each player discards their hand and returns to their hand each card they exiled this way.
note: Sac'd one-shot (honest). Spikes everyone to 7 = max Vise/Owl, then mass discard.

name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
role: manland enabler: symmetric loot on a land; uncounterable wheel pressure
text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}, {T}: Each player draws a card, then discards a card.
note: Land-slot enabler; loots for graveyard + feeds Underworld Dreams. Hard to remove.

name: Mikokoro, Center of the Sea
role: land-slot symmetric draw pump; floods hands for the punisher suite
text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}, {T}: Each player draws a card.
note: Colorless land version of Temple Bell; redundant-axis, surplus land option.

name: Triskaidekaphile
role: HONEST alt-win build-around: win if exactly 13 cards in hand at upkeep
out_of_block_note: MID creature, but a unique hand-size alt-win the block lacks; ties wheel-flood to a win
text:
You have no maximum hand size.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have exactly thirteen cards in your hand, you win the game.
{3}{U}: Draw a card.
note: Out-of-block creature exception: only hand-size alt-win; Puzzle Box/Font hit 13.

name: Viseling
role: CUT CANDIDATE: Iron Maiden on a body; out-of-block + redundant
out_of_block_note: out-of-block artifact creature AND functional Iron Maiden dup
text: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, this creature deals X damage to that player, where X is the number of cards in their hand minus 4.
note: RECOMMEND CUT: violates creature rule (NEM Construct) AND duplicates Iron Maiden.
